## Highlights

**Daily writing, with a document-style top bar.** Open today's journal note,
start from a template, find and replace text, and adjust your writing space.

## New

- **File / Edit / View / Insert menus** sit under the note title, with keyboard
  navigation and shortcuts alongside the commands. The sidebar toggle leads the
  toolbar below. The menus stay available on phones too.
- **Today's note** opens or creates `Journal/YYYY-MM-DD` using your local date.
  Find it in File, in Quick open, or with Alt+J. Existing text stays intact.
- **Templates:** the New note dialog can start with any note in `Templates/`,
  including subfolders. It copies the current Markdown and properties, leaving
  the template as an ordinary editable note.
- **Find and replace** is available from Edit and Quick open. It opens the
  Markdown editor from Write or Preview, keeps Split open, and supports case,
  whole-word and regular-expression searches. Replacements autosave and undo.
- **Writing settings** in View and Quick open offer text size, line width and
  spellcheck in Write. Preferences stay in this browser; Markdown files keep
  their existing format.

## Upgrading

Stop the previous Labradorite process and replace the binary. Your vault,
themes, browser drafts and recovery safeguards carry over. There is no vault
conversion or new service to configure.

## Downloads

One archive for **Linux amd64** holds `labradorite`, the README, the guide, the
license and third-party notices. Check it against `SHA256SUMS`.

[Full changelog: v0.7.0 → v0.8.0](https://github.com/eg36/Labradorite/compare/v0.7.0...v0.8.0)
